channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Politically convenient, not economic: BJP slams Rahul Gandhi's GST remarks
item.description: Reacting to Gandhi's remarks made during an interaction in Berlin, BJP Information Technology Cell Chief Amit Malviya said his statements reflect political convenience rather than a clear understanding of economics.

item.title: Rowdy-sheeter murder case: K'taka Police issue lookout notice against BJP MLA
item.description: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has issued a lookout notice against him. Reacting to the development, Home Minister G. Parameshwara said that legal action would be initiated in the case.

item.title: K'taka Lokayukta raid 10 locations linked to Housing Minister Zameer Ahmed Khan's aide
item.description: Simultaneous raids were carried out in Bengaluru, Madikeri and Mysuru districts by a team of more than 100 Lokayukta officials. In Bengaluru, searches were conducted at Sarfaraz Khan's residence in the Halasuru locality and six other houses in different parts of the city.

item.title: Aditya Dhar takes sly dig at Dhruv Rathee for calling Dhurandhar "propaganda" film
item.description: After Dhruv Rathee's video slamming Dhurandhar and calling it a "dangerous propaganda" film, Aditya Dhar seems to have indirectly hit back.

item.title: Delhi HC asks GST Council to consider lowering 18 pc GST on air purifiers
item.description: Considering the functions performed by air purifiers, a Bench of Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Justice Tushar Rao Gedela observed that it was prima facie of the view that a GST rate of 5 per cent could be extended to them.

item.title: Teacher shot dead on Aligarh Muslim University campus, police probe underway
item.description: The deceased has been identified as Rao Danish, a former student of Aligarh Muslim University. He had been working as a teacher at the ABK High School on the university campus for the past 11 years. According to initial information, on Wednesday night, Rao Danish had stepped out for his routine evening walk along with two colleagues when the incident occurred.

item.title: Varun Dhawan and Pooja Hegde lock lips; BTS clips from sets of Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai leaked
item.description: In the leaked BTS clips, Varun Dhawan and Pooja Hegde are seen getting close during a beachside shoot, with Pooja in a black swimsuit and Varun in a shirt and shorts. Another clip shows Pooja sitting on Varun's lap as they film a romantic scene, with the duo also stepping into the water for a few shots.

item.title: Bharti Singh shares first glimpse of newborn son Kaju, cries holding him; greets paps upon discharged from hospital
item.description: After welcoming her second son on December 19, 2025, Bharti was discharged from the hospital on Wednesday. While heading home, she greeted the paps outside the hospital and joked with the media, "Kaju pak chuka hai," as both she and Haarsh confirmed that their baby is healthy.

item.title: Gold and silver bring cheers for investors, 2026 outlook remains strong
item.description: Silver prices surged by more than 137 per cent -- outperforming gold -- which also posted a strong gain of around 68 per cent this year. With equity markets facing volatility, both metals strengthened their position as preferred safe investment options, but silver clearly outshone all traditional choices.

item.title: Crude bomb explosion kills one in Bangladesh amid deepening crisis
item.description: According to eyewitnesses, an explosive device was thrown from the top of the flyover and detonated on the road below, critically injuring the victim. He was later identified by his relatives as a man named Siam, who succumbed to his injuries shortly after the blast.
